name: perspective/module-observability-otel
description: OpenTelemetry integration package for Magento 2 applications with complete observability stack

suggest.ext-opentelemetry: Required in the PHP runtime that records traces; Composer itself can run without it.
suggest.open-telemetry/opentelemetry-auto-pdo: Install with the standalone OpenTelemetry extension; the PHP distro already includes PDO instrumentation.
